result:
On a saved trends insight in view mode, the chart type gallery now replaces the dropdown. I didn't run typecheck or the tests, and I didn't add a test.

The gallery was hidden in view mode because `isEditableSurface` in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts` required `editMode` to be true. I removed that check, so `canShowAlternatives` no longer depends on it. The other guards are unchanged:
- The insight must not be embedded, shared or in a dashboard.
- The user must be able to edit the insight, with no `editingDisabledReason`.
- The insight must be a trends insight, with the `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES` flag on.

Edit mode behaves as before. Viewers without edit rights still get the plain dropdown, so they don't see the gallery. That was my call, since picking a chart type still changes the insight. If you want read-only viewers to see the gallery too, drop the `canEditInsight` and `editingDisabledReason` conditions as well.

I left the `editMode` prop and selector on the logic, since `ChartAlternatives` and `ChartGallery` still pass it through. `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` always mounts in edit mode, so it doesn't cover view mode. I skipped a new test because I couldn't run it here.
